title: Warranty Coverage Credit of Visit Charges against a Prorated Glass Share
content:
**Schedule.** When an owner accepts a prorated sealed glass replacement under Warranty Coverage, charges booked on the claim's technician visits are credited according to how many calendar days after the claim's decision date the owner accepts:

| Acceptance, days after the decision date | Credited |
|---|---|
| no more than 30 (full-credit window) | the trip and labor charges booked on the claim's visits |
| 31 to 60 (trip-credit window) | only the trip charges booked on the claim's visits |
| more than 60 | nothing |

In clause form: when the owner accepts no more than the full-credit window of 30 days after the decision date, the trip and labor charges booked on the claim's visits are credited; when the owner accepts later but no more than the trip-credit window of 60 days after the decision date, only the trip charges booked on the claim's visits are credited; an owner who accepts later receives no visit credit. Charges on other claims are never credited.

The decision date is the date of the decision that approved the claim with proration.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical decision date 1 March)

| Acceptance date | Days after the decision date | Credited |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March | 30 | trip and labor charges |
| 1 April | 31 | trip charges only |
| 30 April | 60 | trip charges only |
| 1 May | 61 | nothing |

## Case (hypothetical)

The claim's visits carry a trip charge of 64.00 and a labor charge of 132.00, and another claim of the same owner carries a 58.00 trip charge. Accepting 20 days after the decision: 196.00 is credited; accepting 45 days after: 64.00; the 58.00 on the other claim is never credited.
